acceptance: Every claim cites a recorded source and the digests of the nodes it relies on, carries a certainty class and confidence, validates structurally, and goes stale when a cited node changes.

negative.fixture: tampered ids, unrecorded sources, heuristic-only certainty, changed or removed evidence nodes

versions.schema: vsf-observation-snapshot-v1, vsf-recognition-v1, vsf-evidence-ledger-v1, vsf-availability-v1 new; IR 1.0.0 unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: Claims carry node ids and digests, never page text beyond the bound label.
performance_memory_storage: Claim ids are 128-bit content hashes; ledger build is linear in claims.
known_limitations: Verified certainty is not producible by recognition
